body.zh: 三个人、一张桌子、一柜子样品。第一条业务线定为简体中文版发行——先把别人的好游戏做对，再谈做自己的。
body.en: Three people, one table and a cabinet of review copies. The first line on the board was Simplified Chinese publishing: get somebody else's good game right first, then earn the right to make our own.

body.zh: 与 Mighty Boards 达成《阿格莫尼亚》简体中文版协议。术语表在译者动笔之前就交回原出版方确认——这条规矩从第一个项目就立下了。
body.en: Simplified Chinese rights to Agemonia agreed with Mighty Boards. The glossary went back to the original publisher for sign-off before a translator started — a rule set on the very first project.

body.zh: 《阿格莫尼亚》简体中文版众筹完成，中文玩家社群围绕它稳定成型。数字由项目档案自动汇总，不用手改。
body.en: The Agemonia Simplified Chinese edition funded, and a settled Chinese-language community formed around it. The figures below are summed from the project files, never typed in by hand.

body.zh: 《冥烛》进入开发——东方神话盗墓题材，八卦解谜与命运骰系统，十三章战役。机制、叙事、配件工程全部在内部完成。
body.en: Netherworld Candle enters development — an Eastern-mythology tomb adventure built on Bagua puzzles and the Destiny Dice system, across thirteen chapters. Mechanics, narrative and component engineering all in-house.

body.zh: 《冥烛》众筹结束，解锁目标全部按期兑现并发货。交付日期一经公布没有改动过一次。
body.en: Netherworld Candle closed its campaign, unlocked every stretch goal and shipped them all on schedule. The published fulfilment date never moved.

body.zh: 原创开发与简体中文版发行同时推进，团队扩到八人，并开始把中国原创作品带向海外发行商。
body.en: Original development and licensed editions now run in parallel, the team is eight, and we have begun taking Chinese originals out to publishers abroad.
